title: perseid.toml
description: perseid.toml: where the OpenAPI spec comes from, and the SDKs generated from it.

base_url.description: API base URL the clients default to.

csharp.description: The C# SDK, a NuGet package.

exclude.description: Operation ids left out of every SDK.

generate.description: Command writing the spec in the API repository's CI when it isn't committed, run from its root before pushing the spec.

header_prefix.description: Prefix of the SDK's own headers, such as `{prefix}-idempotency-key`: the kebab-case `name` by default.

internal.description: Also generates the operations marked `x-internal: true`.

java.description: The Java SDK, a Maven package.

name.description: Client name, in any form (`Acme`, `acme-api`, `Acme API`): the `AcmeApi` client, the `acme_api` and `acme-api` packages.

names.description: Method names by operation id, over the resource-style names.

only.description: Operation ids to generate, leaving out every other operation.

overrides.description: Directory mirroring `templates/<lang>/…` and `runtime/<lang>/…` to override built-ins: `.perseid` by default.

package.description: Package metadata written into the manifests `perseid init` creates.

pagination.description: Paginated list operations, detected from their query parameter and response shape.

push_on.description: When the spec is pushed to the repository generating the SDKs (with `sdks_repo`, or a `github:` spec).

push_tags.description: Tags pushing the spec with `push_on = "tag"`, as a GitHub Actions glob: `v*` by default.

python.description: The Python SDK, a PyPI package.

repo.description: Default repository of every SDK: `owner/name-{lang}` gives each its own (`{lang}` is `rust`, `node`, `python`, `go`, `java` or `dotnet`), `owner/name` holds them all in folders named after their language. Without it, the SDKs live next to perseid.toml.

sdks_repo.description: `owner/name` of a separate repository this one sends its spec to, which generates the SDKs from its own perseid.toml.

spec.description: The OpenAPI document (3.0 or 3.1, JSON or YAML): a path relative to perseid.toml, an http(s) URL, or `github:owner/repo/path` for a spec another repository pushes here.

timeout.description: Default request timeout, in seconds: 60 by default.

typescript.description: The TypeScript SDK, an npm package.

untagged_unions.description: How unions decode objects that no rule tells apart.

user_agent.description: Prefix of the `User-Agent` header: the kebab-case `name` by default.

webhooks.description: Installs the Standard Webhooks signature verifier in every SDK.

path.description: Output directory, relative to the repository the SDK lives in: the language's name, or the root of a repository of its own.

description.description: One-line summary: `{name} API client` by default.

Pagination.description: How a list operation pages, as `x-pagination` on an operation or `[pagination]` in perseid.toml. Exactly one of `cursor`, `page` or `offset` names the query parameter selecting the page; response values are dotted paths of JSON property names.

cursor.description: Query parameter taking the cursor of the page.

first_page.description: Number of the first page, 1 by default.

has_more.description: Boolean telling whether more pages follow.

item_cursor.description: Field of the last item that is the next cursor, e.g. `id` for `starting_after`.

items.description: The array of items, `data` by default.

next_cursor.description: Cursor of the next page in the response.

offset.description: Query parameter taking the index of the first item.

operations.description: perseid.toml only: operations this rule must apply to, instead of every matching one.

page.description: Query parameter taking the page number.

total.description: Total number of items, for offset pagination.

PushOn.description: When the API repository pushes its spec.

oneOf.description: Every push to the default branch changing the spec.
